title: The First Page
message: wandered beneath the glowing corals of Moonlit Reef and recovered {reward} Star Candies from an ancient Elven shrine. A folded page rested beneath the moonstone altar~

title: The Definitely Shorter Path
message: followed a trail of silver shells through Moonlit Reef after finding one of Shizuki's handwritten shortcuts. The path somehow led in a complete circle, but a hidden tidepool held {reward} Star Candies and another folded page~

title: A Sprite in the Coral
message: followed a flicker of moonlight between the corals and met a tiny Moon Sprite guarding {reward} Star Candies. It darted away, leaving one of Shizuki's folded pages behind~

title: The Reef Worth Sketching
message: paused beneath a sweeping arch of luminous coral where Shizuki had left a half-finished sketch beside {reward} Star Candies and another journal page~

title: The Berry Thief
message: chased a bold little crab through the reef after it stole Shizuki's berry pouch. The thief surrendered beside a cache of {reward} Star Candies and a folded page~

title: Moon Jelly Lanterns
message: drifted beneath a bloom of glowing moon jellies that gathered around Shizuki's trail marks. Their light revealed {reward} Star Candies and another page caught beneath a shell~

title: Starlight Lagoon
message: reached Starlight Lagoon by following Shizuki's directions marked 'probably east.' Glimmer uncovered {reward} Star Candies beneath the silver water along with another folded page~

title: The Silverfin Council
message: found a school of Silverfin gathered around one of Shizuki's sketches as though holding a serious meeting. Beneath them rested {reward} Star Candies and a damp journal page~

title: The Accidental Current
message: was swept through the reef when one of Shizuki's experimental runes awakened a Lunar Current. It deposited you safely beside {reward} Star Candies and another folded page~

title: The Moonkeeper Watches
message: encountered the mysterious Fae Moonkeeper beside a silver shrine. After reading one of Shizuki's abandoned direction signs, the Moonkeeper silently granted {reward} Star Candies and left behind another page~

title: Sea Blossoms at Dusk
message: wandered through a garden of glowing Fae Sea Blossoms planted along Shizuki's route. Their petals opened to reveal {reward} Star Candies and a carefully folded page~

title: Moonglass Reflections
message: entered Moonglass Cavern and found Shizuki's arrows reflected across every crystal wall. After following several wrong copies, you discovered {reward} Star Candies and another page~

title: The Elder's Test
message: met an Elder Moon Turtle resting across Shizuki's marked path. It allowed passage only after Glimmer uncovered {reward} Star Candies and a weathered journal page beneath its shell~

title: Moonbeam Cascade
message: followed drifting pages through Moonbeam Cascade, where silver light traced Shizuki's winding route toward {reward} Star Candies and another entry from her journal~

title: When Stars Fell
message: crossed Moonlit Reef during a gentle celestial starfall. Shizuki and Glimmer had gathered fallen sparks around {reward} Star Candies and tucked another page beneath them~

title: Treasures of the Astral Tide
message: reached a quiet shore where the Astral Tide had arranged Shizuki's lost supplies beside {reward} Star Candies and another folded journal page~

title: The Manta's Invitation
message: was guided by a majestic Astral Manta Ray along a route marked in Shizuki's handwriting. It carried you to {reward} Star Candies and another page hidden in a Fae cache~

title: Echoes Beneath the Sand
message: heard the Echoing Star Reef repeat one of Shizuki's cheerful humming tunes. Following the sound uncovered {reward} Star Candies and another journal page beneath the sand~

title: Beneath the Moonstone Arch
message: passed beneath the ancient Moonstone Arch, where Shizuki's newest shortcut pointed in two directions at once. The correct path held {reward} Star Candies and another page~

title: The Lantern Left Behind
message: discovered Shizuki's enchanted lantern glowing beside a set of hurried footprints. Its light revealed {reward} Star Candies and another folded page beneath the waves~

title: The Starshell Bargain
message: found Shizuki negotiating with a Starshell Hermit using three berries and an extremely questionable map. The hermit accepted and revealed {reward} Star Candies with another page~

title: The Star Pearl
message: opened a radiant Star Pearl Oyster after following a clue in Shizuki's journal. Inside rested {reward} Star Candies and another page protected by pearlescent magic~

title: The Celestial Garden
message: wandered into a Celestial Coral Garden where every bloom leaned toward Shizuki's passing trail. At its center waited {reward} Star Candies and another folded page~

title: The Compass That Disagreed
message: uncovered an ancient Elvish Star Compass that spun wildly near Shizuki's map. When both finally pointed the same way, they led to {reward} Star Candies and another page~

title: Moonveil Grove
message: rested among glowing Moonveil Anemones where Shizuki had hidden a berry snack. Beneath the grove you found {reward} Star Candies and another journal page~

title: The Whispering Tidepool
message: arrived at a tidepool that whispered fragments of Shizuki's earlier notes. The voices guided you toward {reward} Star Candies and one more folded page~

title: A Fallen Constellation
message: found Shizuki and Glimmer rearranging fragments of a fallen constellation. When the final star clicked into place, it revealed {reward} Star Candies and another page~

title: The Dreaming Lilies
message: crossed a meadow of Dreaming Sea Lilies that showed glimpses of Shizuki's journey. One bloom opened to reveal {reward} Star Candies and another folded page~

title: The Moonkeeper's Vault
message: found Shizuki waiting beside a forgotten Fae vault while the Moonkeeper watched from afar. The recovered key opened a chamber containing {reward} Star Candies and another page~

title: The Astral Heart
message: reached the heart of Moonlit Reef where Shizuki and Glimmer stood before an ancient relic. It awakened in silver light, granting {reward} Star Candies and the final page of the chapter~ / LEGENDARY EXPEDITION!
